gate.method: nearest-rank P95 over browser-observed navigation-to-visible samples

warmup.reason: Exclude one-time production asset transfer from the steady-state navigation gate while retaining independent browser contexts.

sourceChanges: Home career-path counts use one grouped public-job query instead of one search per career path.
The production build was rebuilt with next build and served with next start for both runs.
The duplicate historical home-browser wrapper was byte-identical to the desktop evidence and was removed during canonicalization.
limitations: This is a local production-mode rehearsal with an isolated database; it is not a multi-region production load test.
The benchmark does not close the separate realtime cross-process adapter validation or automated object-storage backup scope.
